newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-BIDOUANE PULLS OF HURDLES SHOCK.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BIDOUANE PULLS OF HURDLES SHOCK.

text.p: Morocco's Nezha Bidouane pulled off one of the biggest shocks of the world championships on Friday with a dramatic late run to win the women's 400 metres hurdles final.

After hitting the home straight several strides away from Olympic champion Deon Hemmings and defending champion Kim Batten, the Moroccan produced a remarkable last 100 metres and pipped Hemmings on the line with a late burst after the final hurdle.
Bidouane, who has never done anything of significance at a major championship before, finished in 52.97 seconds with Hemmings second in 53.09. World record holder Batten hung on for third in 53.52.
